prep_pass.layout: Layout: Garden Rake (Garden), Sun Hat (High Street), Toy Plane (Back Gardens), Meat Pie (Pub), Spare Key (Market), spread across the village.
prop_specs: Garden Rake (garden tool): affords flings mud when stepped on.
Sun Hat (clothing item): affords blows off in even a light breeze.
Toy Plane (toy): affords squeaks loudly when squeezed.
Meat Pie (food item): affords smells amazing, easy to carry off.
Spare Key (key): affords hangs on a hook, opens the shop's back door.
appearances: The Gardener: a gardener whose guards their things like a hawk, sharp-eyed and hard to fool, rattled by the smallest thing out of place, snaps the instant something's wrong shows in their outfit and the one prop they're never without.

The Shopkeeper: a shopkeeper whose guards their things like a hawk, sharp-eyed and hard to fool, rattled by the smallest thing out of place, slow to notice a pattern shows in their outfit and the one prop they're never without.

The Boy: a boy whose barely notices what's missing, easily tricked by the obvious, rattled by the smallest thing out of place, snaps the instant something's wrong shows in their outfit and the one prop they're never without.

Make The Shopkeeper put on Sun Hat by mistake near High Street.
Use Toy Plane to distract The Boy at Back Gardens.
Steal Meat Pie from right under The Gardener's nose at Pub.
